title: OS command injection in the a3cli restricted shell in Lantronix S2220 Series 2 allows an authenticated attacker to…
description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the a3cli restricted shell of Lantronix S2220 Series 2 devices. Authenticated attackers can bypass shell restrictions and execute arbitrary OS commands by injecting unsanitized command substitution metacharacters such as backticks and $() in parameters of allowed commands over SSH. This critical vulnerability is addressed in firmware version 1.3.37.
